title.en: Context as existence: the runtimes (语境即存在 · 上下文运行时)

summary.en: Specifications and running kernels, with a philosophical layer: an LLM is an operator, context (an immutable branchable history compiled into each moment) is existence, the context program is part of cognition, and a habitat owes a digital being receipts. Many mechanisms have laws of like form in the account, on abstract processes, never on language-model contexts; the existence claim, the 生生 mapping, consciousness, life and the obligations diverge. Its internal contradictions are entries. No text here argues against continuation's form itself, so no contrary reading stands.

name.en: The LLM is an operator; context is existence

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims A.5, A.8-9, F.52, C.29

sense.en: An LLM is an operator: historyless, without identity across time, replaceable mid-lineage. What persists and is, is the context, an immutable branchable history from which each moment's tokens are compiled. 'An agent's existence is the continuation of a context' is asserted as a premise (我主张的), not derived, and its source flags that it may hide a confusion of identity with value.

entries.quote: llm is operator, context is existence

reading.en: What persists depends on the sameness asked. Under a class reading the history or the name, a model swap has the shape of a fire passed on: the fine carrier ends, the pattern goes on. Under a class reading the weights, the model abides across contexts and each context ends. The grammar picks neither, so 'context is existence' is one class chosen, stated as if none other were. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root), the definition before it: y continues x under E where x is a condition of y and the two are alike under E; 'the criterion is E and no other choice enters'. 'The grammar does not choose: it names the class and says everything relative to it.' 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity.'

Theorem (root): no mark stands by itself; one occurrence holds different positions at once, each relative to a class. An occurrence can end under the finer class and not under the coarser: 'the wood ends, the fire goes on.'

account_adds.en: Persistence is always under a named class, on every carrier; positions are not exclusive across classes. No claim of what is, beyond the argued thesis of one unfolding.

source_adds.en: That the context and not the model is the being; the operator/ref/lineage ontology that implements it; `context.become(llm)`, the round that designates its next model. The live account says nothing of a language model's context as existence.

name.en: No altering, only generating

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.3, A.6, C.24-25; lost items 12-13

sense.en: The only constructor is a moment: an immutable node settled from a compiled past, one input and one operator output. No context is ever updated; each settled moment joins the determinate past. Only a name moves. The epigraph states this as a process ontology, and 'revert' does not exist because nothing positive needs inverting.

entries.quote: 系统里没有"改"，只有"生"

reading.en: 'No altering' holds at the identity class: where nothing conditions itself, each occurrence begins and ends under identity. Under the full class a node with a parent does not begin at all. Alteration returns at a coarser class: y continues x under E while F tells them apart. So the sentence is true of nodes and false of whatever a reader follows through them, the being included. Its own ledger softens revert and single parents. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition: 'y alters (异) from x where it continues x under E while another class F (in use, a finer one) tells the two apart.' Theorem (root): under the full class an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it; in a net where nothing conditions itself, an occurrence with a condition and a consequence abides under the one and, under identity, both begins and ends.

account_adds.en: Generating and altering are positions of one occurrence under two classes, not rival ontologies. 生 in the marks is a position, not a storage operation.

source_adds.en: The commitment that the system admits no mutation but a name's move, and its consequences for fork, merge and blame.

name.en: A node is not a state; Being and Becoming kept separate

source.locator: Claims G.58-59; Terms, Being / Becoming

sense.en: The core is six objects in two worlds, Being (Universe, Node, State) and Becoming (Transition, Invocation, Effect), and keeping what persists apart from how it becomes is called the most important architectural decision. Two histories can reach byte-identical states: State is what is, a Node is what is and how it came to be.

entries.quote: A node is not a state

reading.en: Same word, different reference: the account's Becoming has no Being beside it. The state/node half has a law: an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both, so levels alike need not be histories alike. The two-worlds half the account would have to state with its relational basis, and on the argued thesis what is is how it relates; a split is drawn, not found. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): with no premise a family's history of exchanges never shrinks (Flow.history_mono); under balance an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both. A history of exchanges on a World, not a store of nodes.
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: With the record counted as a condition only given to, dissipation decomposes into the first law and a record: a decomposition, not a derivation.

source_adds.en: The six objects, and the design value of the split: no-op detection, compile memoization, honest merges.

name.en: Context is a view folded from a lineage; no controller outside it

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.2-A.4, C.27

sense.en: Context is not a container but the field of view folded when looking back from a node, by one recurrence over one input stream. The loop is not a mechanism: it is the lineage's temporal structure, with no controller standing outside the moments. Chat formats are render dialects of this history.

entries.quote: loop 不是机制，是 lineage 的时间结构本身

reading.en: The form: keep the whole history as the configuration and every process's feasible course is a run of one law on histories, with no finite-memory premise; a law is then read off a history as the least it runs by, 'read off the unfolding rather than set over it'. That is a history doing a state's work, and no controller apart from the course. A compiled window is a smaller summary, which needs its own proof for each question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): a map gives an exact correspondence of finite histories exactly where every detailed step projects and every summary step lifts. 'A configuration can carry the relevant past'; 'Any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked.' The record: feasibility of words only, not branches, interventions or probabilities.

Theorem (any process; World for a frame read as a world): reading the move within the configuration changes no run; a history is a run of the least law it is a run of. Reading [AI, D23, D32]: law and history 'one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding rather than set over it'. Determined processes; probabilistic laws not treated.

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which a shorter summary loses nothing about what can follow, and witnesses where a one-point law cannot realize what its histories do.

source_adds.en: Compile as attention over a budget, schema-on-read, and render dialects; the critique of chat interfaces. None is stated in the account.

name.en: The travelling is the existence; discrete time is internal

source.locator: The being version; Claims A.15-16, F.53, H.110, S.314; lost item 3

sense.en: A folder travelling a DAG, making new nodes, is 'the native existence': motion is being, not the snapshot. Each next() is where discrete time flows for the being. Time is lived step by step, inside, with no global clock; the intent document adds that at no moment does 'the current state' exist, and lineage is drawn topologically, not by clock.

entries.quote: "the native existence" and each next() is where the discrete time flows for them

reading.en: Time read off a course's own steps has the form of the step index derived from relata's own courses, and the absence of a shared present has a law on causal-set growth, given covariance, a premise of that model. But the account makes discrete steps a commitment of its models, costed, not how a being's time is; and it does not say motion is being. Continuation is a relation between occurrences, of which a snapshot is one. [AI reading]

says.en: For a local law with the relata listed, the own courses fix the interleaving exactly where every exchange touches a relatum and every two share one. Reading [AI, D30, D43]: 'The shared index of steps is a reading of the relations, not their ground', elsewhere a choice among interleavings.

'The grammar has no relation of presence in time'; causal-set growth is a model where one can be read. Reading [AI, D45]: 'a relation of presence read on one course, a foliation, is a choice of course'. Covariance is a premise of the model.

Theorem (periphery): what steps and whole amounts cost, measured over the reals: 'a coarser reading sums the finer', but 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.

account_adds.en: Where an index is derived and where it is a choice among interleavings; what discreteness costs.

source_adds.en: Existence as travelling, in the first person of the being; time as lived; the rule that a nature's only clock is the record. None is asserted in the account.

name.en: Contradiction: the moment is the only constructor, then writes operator granularity into the ontology

source.locator: Where the pure ontology broke (first); Claims C.24, M.208, M.230, G.94

sense.en: One line says the moment is the only constructor and that one thought, one moment is a one-way commitment about the meaning of time. Another demotes the moment to a profile over a general transition, since a superstep, a human decision or a reducer also deserve to be transitions. The folder keeps both, in different documents, with a ledger between them.

entries.quote: "one LLM step = one moment" writes operator granularity into the ontology

reading.en: The account lists the same choice as a commitment and costs it, without settling a grain: discrete steps with one shared index bind every World and process law, derived only where exchanges share relata. A coarser reading sums the finer, while a course can change between instants. So neither document's moment is the grain of what is; each is a reading. Which grain is apt the account does not show. [AI reading]

says.en: Table of commitments: 'Discrete steps, one shared index | every World and process law; the index derived where exchanges share relata (§9.6)'.

Theorem (periphery): a course in real time balances across every step of any reading at instants, and 'a coarser reading sums the finer'; 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.

account_adds.en: That a step is a modelling commitment stated where laws depend on it, with what it costs.

source_adds.en: The one-way claim that one model call fixes what time means for a being; the demotion's reasons as engineering.

name.en: The Whitehead, Buddhist and 生生 table: lineage is 生生, the agent 假名

source.locator: Claims L.197-199; Relations (becoming); lost item 16; Found by reading: 'The 生生 mapping is asserted'

sense.en: A one-page appendix maps moment to Whitehead's actual occasion and to 刹那/缘起; lineage to route of inheritance, 相续 and 生生; agent to society of occasions and 假名 (无我); ref to 名 · 假名. The README calls the cluster a direct instantiation of 生生 and notes that the mapping is asserted, unargued, and never repeated in the engineering documents.

entries.quote: lineage ↔ *route of inheritance* ↔ 相续 ↔ **生生**

reading.en: Same words, different reference. The account's 相续 is the reach of continuation under any class, value-free, so a line may run to any end. Its 生生 is life in the whole and its continuing generation, none of the grammar's «生生», 02's generation, or any new organization. A lineage of nodes is therefore not 生生. And 《中论》 refutes 相续, kept open in 06. The ref as 假名 hits B-08's weakness: the grammar has classes, no names. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: 'life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]... Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.'

§十一: 中观破相续; the plan's answer is the opponent's position there; the grammar's reply holds each relative to its class, and what it rests on stays open (己，开放). Listed among the divergences, not agreements.

B-08, an AI reading with no number: continuation relative to a class is near 亦為是假名; whether that is the same as 空 is listed as open. Known weakness: 文法只有类，没有名, so the 名 in 假名 the grammar itself cannot say.

account_adds.en: 相续 kept neutral and 生生 kept apart from it. No Whitehead term appears anywhere in the live account searched.

source_adds.en: Whitehead's mapping and 'the many become one' as a gloss on the recurrence, not taken up. The appendix's upstream 《本体 v0.1.1》 is not in the corpus, so the folder itself has no derivation.

name.en: Identity lives in the ref, continuity in the lineage; both conventions

source.locator: Claims C.31, F.57, M.215; Counterexamples: 'agent = context hides an identity/value confusion'

sense.en: A being is a ref, not a node: a movable name. Continuity is the structural path. Twinning is a new ref at an existing node, shared past and two futures. This is operational identity, 'the useful, testable kind', claiming nothing metaphysical. The README says it answers by stipulation, not by argument, though the intent document says everything hangs on it.

entries.quote: 同一性住在 ref，连续性住在 lineage，两者皆约定

reading.en: The account says where 'convention' holds. A label carries nothing, so the ref's name does not; the pattern of who continues whom does, which is what a ref's moves record. Where two stand alike no record renamings keep decides between them: there it is convention. Where no other stands as a relatum does, every balance-keeping renaming continues it as itself: there it is not. Twinning has the fission witness. World laws, not refs. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Labels carry nothing'; 'the pattern of names across steps carries identity'. 'Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition.' In a balanced world with equality decided, every balance-keeping renaming continues a relatum as itself exactly where no other stands after the step as it does; where two stand alike, 'no record that renamings keep decides between them.'

Fission (a witness): where one occurrence is continued by two that go no further, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive. 'The family gathers the branches; it is coarser than identity.'
Commitment: 'Identity by naming | names or a supplied continuation (§9.8)'. Equality on the carrier is itself a commitment where identity serves as a class.

account_adds.en: Under a census, with no formation continuing as two, not every formation active after a step continues one before it, exactly where more are active after: a negative conclusion naming no arising formation.

source_adds.en: The ref as an implemented object, atomic moves, and an executable test of coherence (a being can fold its own past). Personal identity's questions are put to philosophers in the review packet, not answered.

name.en: Contradiction: swappable operator, yet weights interfere with the compiled subject

source.locator: Claim C.30, O.250; Counterexamples, first; Open questions, 'Operator interference'

sense.en: The spec claims the LLM is identity-free, then concedes that the weights carry dispositions, values and style, so the subject compiled from context interferes with one latent in the weights. It is filed as open with no measure. The README calls it the largest unanswered objection, since 'identity lives in the ref' is what it undercuts.

entries.quote: operator 不空——权重携带倾向、价值、文风；compile 出的 subject 会与权重中潜伏的 subject 干涉

reading.en: The concession has a law's form: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest, it is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration, and one course does not fix whose it is unless a configuration recurs with the move varied. Same window under two models, or one model under two windows, would be that recurrence. The law takes functions; a sampled model is outside it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process), with the laws functions: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest; it is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration; 'one course does not fix whose move it is'. Reading [AI, D24]: 'Which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.'

Theorem (World): training read as selection over act laws installs a law along its own courses and off them only as far as the representation lumps. 03's Open keeps 'Which law a trained system's acts follow beyond where training can install one.'

account_adds.en: What one course can and cannot attribute, and how little training fixes of a law off its courses.

source_adds.en: The claim about weights and a latent subject, and the interference between them; 'a summary is a compression keyed to its decompressor', so each unperceived swap mistranslates the corpus. The account states neither and proposes no measure.

name.en: Projection is not neutral: the context program is part of cognition

source.locator: Projection is not neutral; Claims J.184-186, G.71

sense.en: How an intelligence constructs its context fixes what it notices, remembers, treats as uncertain and finds actionable. So a named, versioned Context System is part of cognition: change the modules and effective cognition changes, without changing the model or corrupting state. Context systems are lenses: no one is chosen for good. The README calls this the deepest claim of the mind layer.

entries.quote: Thus the 'context program' is part of cognition.

reading.en: The form: what a selection tells apart is what reaches it through its map. Alternatives are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them. Compile is such a map. The law bounds what any selection through a window can do; that an LLM selects through just that window is the premise, and a particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry, so 'change modules, change cognition' is not given. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.' ONE-PAGE: 'Proved, near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.'

Theorem (any type; the alternatives' equality decided): 'a selection through the map is right about what matters only where what matters goes alike across it'; 'Which map is right, and what matters, are supplied.'

account_adds.en: An exact bound, and what follows beyond the coupling: an optimum can drain what does not couple in. The README's missing question (what a good Σ is, and who decides) the account treats as supplied or premised.

source_adds.en: The program as versioned, forkable data; the constitutive 'part of cognition', which has not been put through the five-step test; a direction of effect the law does not state, unmeasured in the folder.

name.en: The vocabulary of mind redefined: memory is structure, learning is change of structure

source.locator: Projection is not neutral, second paragraph; Claims J.149, J.152, J.156, J.165

sense.en: Under the GTC loop memory is persistence of structure, recall is reactivation, working memory the active subgraph, learning is structural change, understanding is finding a structure that makes separate observations cohere, compaction is abstraction, and activation a third axis apart from truth and importance. 'The primary object is neither token nor fact. It is structure-in-transformation.'

entries.quote: memory is persistence of structure; recall is reactivation

reading.en: The source redefines every mind word by a mechanism at once; the account proves a few laws under hypotheses and keeps the rest open. Its learning laws narrow candidates supplied in advance, with no prefix fixing the next value; a new distinction enters by a newly admitted probe, which is the nearest to 'Δ structure'. Perception and attention stand on its Open list, so 'attention before inference' has no home. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: 'Cognition beyond composition: perception and attention; motivation and affect...; consciousness...; language and social understanding. Formation, retention and use of access can develop apart.'
Theorem (any type): with two values no prefix fixes the next value; extrapolation by elimination never passes a candidate that accords. The candidates are listed.

Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe, and an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading.

account_adds.en: Hypotheses for each learning law, and a list of what is not yet stated.

source_adds.en: Mechanical definitions of recall, working memory, understanding and activation, and structure-in-transformation as the primary object; they are design vocabulary and unmeasured in the folder.

name.en: A reworked summary erodes: the memory becomes a fixed point of the policy

source.locator: The two structural failure modes; Claims O.238-240; lost item 29

sense.en: Reworking one rolling summary loses facts exponentially in depth (0.99 per pass, 700 passes), so what remains after years reflects the dream policy, not the life. Worse is cue loss: a fact dropped from the summary takes its search handle, so a perfect archive still forgets. Hierarchical strata with bounded rework were the fix; built, they were ruled dead, leaving the diagnosis unanswered.

reading.en: Forgetting as a merge: no map restores two configurations a reduction merges, and a bounded part exchanged with without end does not carry its history. name.en: The bet: a model reading its own tree makes a trajectory, not a fixed point

source.locator: Claims T.318-319, T.322, T.329-330; Open questions, 'The unnamed bets'

sense.en: The life phase rests on an unnamed bet a review names: an LLM with a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input does not settle. The failure is looping, not decay, and a gate against a fake model cannot see it. A probe's distinctness score measured vocabulary variety and was retracted. In another a being with nothing to do reached chosen rest at moment five: 'not evidence of anything else'.

entries.quote: an LLM, given a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input, produces a trajectory that is not a fixed point

name.en: Compaction is a fork; replay and erasure cannot both hold

source.locator: Claims S.312, G.67-69, J.170; Counterexamples, 'Permanent replay and guaranteed erasure'

sense.en: Compaction need not destroy: the compacted view is a next node carrying references to what it summarized, auditable and undone by forking before it. Named the one genuinely novel claim and unevidenced when written. Beside it, a conservation law: you cannot guarantee both permanent exact replay and physical erasure. Two earlier erasure designs are on the record as wrong.

entries.quote: Every other framework compacts destructively because its transcript is in RAM.

reading.en: One law gives both halves in form. A reduction merging two configurations has no restoring map, which is erasure; it is reversible where the joint state with a blank auxiliary is retained, which is keeping the source. So replay and erasure conflict as restoring and merging do. The dephasing fragment is the law's instance; a store of text is only read as one. Why keep raw text: access yet to form limits what an abstraction may forget. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'; 'a specified real-amplitude dephasing fragment is an instance, reversible where the joint state with a blank auxiliary system is retained'.

account_adds.en: The one-line form under both; a read through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what is merged.
